description: Estudiantes de CBTA 42 Técnicos en Administración de Emprendimientos
summary: A game designed for children aged 7 to 12, which helps them gain experience and improve their decision-making skills. We also involve the children in the process by asking for their input on what they would really like to see in the game. It features characters that evolve throughout the missions, allies who provide assistance, as well as tips and fun facts from NASA.
details: This game relies on the ability of the children—or the person in charge—to interact with its content. It helps children understand the various missions and elements within the game, for instance, by having them read interesting facts that appear throughout the experience. A key component is our use of a highly advanced artificial intelligence system. We believe the project is engaging, as we have successfully combined game mechanics with education about space, allowing children to learn while they play.
projectRefs: The 8 PLANETS of the Solar System and their characteristics – For KIDS
